comment: Dr. MacAllister is as intelligent as she is sweet. So understanding, too!

she will probably be the nicest person you will ever meet.  And she loves teaching.  that being said she is crazy.  she isn't even sure what she expects from assignments.  while the class was easy, i think its merely chance that i got an A as opposed to a D.  No tests as she doesnt believe in grades.  Seriously: she's crazy.
She's so nice, and if you go to her, she will be sure to help. She's absolutely AMAZING. Lot's of reading but really reasonable online quizzes. She changes her class arrangement fairly often, though.
She is such a sweet lady and really helpful.  Her classes require A LOT of work, but it's not hard.  Participate in class and submit all assignments,on time, and you will do just fine!

Easy to do well and actually learn something if you do the work. The class is certainly introductory, so do not expect it to be as useful in the classroom as 300-level classes. Class is geared a lot more toward elementary ed than secondary. I'd recommend this class so long as your interest in education is high.

Diverse learners is a ton of work, but she's really sweet.  It's nice to have a professor who writes "Good Job!" and "Beautiful" on your papers, even when they're not that great.  She's nice, but gives nauseating amts of busy work.
